thesaurus.title: Thesaurus
thesaurus.description: Controlled-vocabulary libraries (microthesauri) that expand your documents with hierarchical terms at index time.
thesaurus.blankTitle: You don't have any thesaurus library yet.
thesaurus.blankDescription: Create a library to organize controlled vocabularies by language and domain.
thesaurus.microthesauriDesc: Each microthesaurus is one term tree for a single language and domain.
thesaurus.chooseMethod: Choose how to create the microthesaurus.
thesaurus.wizardStepInfo: Step 1 of 2 · Give the thesaurus a name and description.
thesaurus.wizardStepMicro: Step 2 of 2 · Add the first microthesaurus (or skip for now).
thesaurus.noMicrothesauri: No microthesauri yet. Add one below.
thesaurus.noMicrothesauriWizard: No microthesauri yet. Use "New microthesaurus" to create one.
thesaurus.languageAndDomainDesc: The single language (ISO code) and knowledge domain of this tree.
thesaurus.termTreeDesc: Browse and curate the broader/narrower hierarchy. Click a row to expand; hover to add a child or delete.
thesaurus.noTerms: No terms yet. Add a root term to start the tree.
thesaurus.deleteTermConfirm: Delete "{{name}}" and all of its child terms?
thesaurus.libraryDesc: Import a ready-made microthesaurus, or upload your own Turing Thesaurus XML.
thesaurus.uploadFailed: Could not import the file. Check it is a valid Turing Thesaurus XML.
thesaurus.generateDesc: Draft a controlled-vocabulary hierarchy from a domain and language. Nothing is saved until you review and create it.
thesaurus.generateHint: Uses the default LLM; the draft is never saved automatically.
thesaurus.generateGuidancePlaceholder: e.g. focus on higher education and distance learning
thesaurus.generateFailed: Generation failed. Check the default LLM supports structured output.
thesaurus.perSiteDesc: Select which controlled vocabularies this site expands documents with at index time, and tune the backing field.
thesaurus.indexConfigDesc: How recognized terms are written to the search index.
thesaurus.enableExpansionHint: When off, this site indexes exactly as before (no expansion).
thesaurus.includeSynonymsHint: Also match USE/USED-FOR non-preferred terms and expand to the preferred term.
thesaurus.pathFacetHint: Also write level-prefixed path tokens (0/Disease, 1/Disease/Respiratory disease, …) to a second field for drill-down browse faceting.
thesaurus.selectedMicrothesauriDesc: The microthesauri this site expands with. Toggle to enable/disable without removing.
thesaurus.noSelections: No microthesauri selected. Add one below to enable expansion.
thesaurus.noVariations: No variations — the label itself is still recognized.
